options.content: 🏠 Accueil📟 Vue d'ensemble🕒 Chronologie💤 États🚗 Trajets📈 Stats conduite🧳 Voyage🛣️ Kilométrage🍃 Efficacité🔌 Recharges📊 Stats recharge⚡ Énergie réelle🔋 Santé batterie🎚️ Niveau de charge📏 Autonomie🧛 Pertes à l'arrêt🌡️ Températures📍 Lieux🗺️ Visites🗓️ Statistiques⬆️ Mises à jour🗄️ Base de données
🧳 BILAN DU VOYAGE  —  règle la période en haut à droite sur les dates de ton voyage

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(date, '30s') AS time, avg(latitude) AS latitude, avg(longitude) AS longitude
FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH dr AS (SELECT d.*, car.efficiency FROM drives d JOIN cars car ON car.id = d.car_id
            WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL),
ch AS (SELECT cp.*, (SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(c.fast_charger_present) OR NULLIF(max(c.charger_phases), 0) IS NULL THEN 'DC' ELSE 'AC' END FROM charges c WHERE c.charging_process_id = cp.id) AS typ FROM charging_processes cp
       WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0),
pos AS (SELECT (SELECT ${preferred_range}_battery_range_km FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND ${preferred_range}_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date LIMIT 1) AS r0,
               (SELECT ${preferred_range}_battery_range_km FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND ${preferred_range}_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS r1)
SELECT (SELECT sum(distance) FROM dr) AS "Distance",
  (SELECT sum(duration_min) * 60 FROM dr) AS "Conduite",
  (SELECT sum(duration_min) * 60 FROM ch) AS "Recharge",
  (SELECT sum(distance) / nullif(sum(duration_min), 0) * 60 FROM dr) AS "Vitesse en roulant",
  (SELECT sum(distance) FROM dr) / nullif(((SELECT sum(duration_min) FROM dr) + COALESCE((SELECT sum(duration_min) FROM ch WHERE typ = 'DC'), 0)) / 60.0, 0) AS "Vitesse avec pauses",
  (SELECT sum((start_${preferred_range}_range_km - end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * efficiency) * 100 / nullif(sum(distance), 0) FROM dr) AS "Conso roulage",
  ((pos.r0 + COALESCE((SELECT sum(end_${preferred_range}_range_km - start_${preferred_range}_range_km) FROM ch), 0) - pos.r1) * (SELECT efficiency FROM cars WHERE id = $car_id))
     * 100 / nullif((SELECT sum(distance) FROM dr), 0) AS "Conso réelle",
  (SELECT sum(charge_energy_added) FROM ch) AS "kWh",
  (SELECT sum(cost) FROM ch) AS "Coût", (SELECT sum(cost) FROM ch) * 100 / nullif((SELECT sum(distance) FROM dr), 0) AS "Coût aux 100 km",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM dr) AS "Trajets", (SELECT count(*) FROM ch) AS "Recharges"
FROM pos

panels.title: Vitesse avec pauses
panels.description: Inclut les pauses aux bornes rapides (DC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Conduite' AS metric, sum(duration_min) * 60 AS value FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date) AND end_date IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'Recharge ' || (SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(c.fast_charger_present) OR NULLIF(max(c.charger_phases), 0) IS NULL THEN 'DC' ELSE 'AC' END FROM charges c WHERE c.charging_process_id = cp.id), sum(duration_min) * 60 FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

WITH ev AS (
  SELECT start_date AS t, CASE state WHEN 'online' THEN 5 WHEN 'asleep' THEN 4 ELSE 3 END AS s FROM states WHERE car_id = $car_id AND start_date < $__timeTo()::timestamp AND COALESCE(end_date, now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') > $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '2 days'
  UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[start_date + interval '1 second', end_date]), unnest(ARRAY[1, 5]) FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id AND start_date < $__timeTo()::timestamp AND COALESCE(end_date, now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') > $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '2 days'
  UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[start_date + interval '1 second', end_date]), unnest(ARRAY[2, 5]) FROM charging_processes WHERE car_id = $car_id AND start_date < $__timeTo()::timestamp AND COALESCE(end_date, now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') > $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '2 days'
  UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[start_date + interval '1 second', end_date]), unnest(ARRAY[6, 5]) FROM updates WHERE car_id = $car_id AND start_date < $__timeTo()::timestamp AND COALESCE(end_date, now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') > $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '2 days'
)
SELECT t AS time, s AS "État" FROM ev WHERE t IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t, s

SELECT d.id, floor(extract(epoch FROM d.start_date) * 1000) AS start_ms, floor(extract(epoch FROM d.end_date) * 1000) + 1000 AS end_ms, d.start_date AS "Départ le",
  COALESCE(sg.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(sa.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', sa.road, sa.house_number), '')), COALESCE(sa.city, sa.neighbourhood))) AS "De", COALESCE(eg.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(ea.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', ea.road, ea.house_number), '')), COALESCE(ea.city, ea.neighbourhood))) AS "Vers", d.distance AS "Km", d.duration_min * 60 AS "Durée",
  (d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km - d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * car.efficiency * 100 / nullif(d.distance, 0) AS "Conso"
FROM drives d JOIN cars car ON car.id = d.car_id
  LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
  LEFT JOIN geofences sg ON sg.id = d.start_geofence_id LEFT JOIN geofences eg ON eg.id = d.end_geofence_id
  LEFT JOIN positions sp ON sp.id = d.start_position_id LEFT JOIN positions ep ON ep.id = d.end_position_id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.start_date

SELECT cp.id, floor(extract(epoch FROM cp.start_date) * 1000) AS start_ms, floor(extract(epoch FROM cp.end_date) * 1000) + 1000 AS end_ms, cp.start_date AS "Le",
  COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), '')), COALESCE(a.city, a.neighbourhood))) AS "Lieu", (SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(c.fast_charger_present) OR NULLIF(max(c.charger_phases), 0) IS NULL THEN 'DC' ELSE 'AC' END FROM charges c WHERE c.charging_process_id = cp.id) AS "Type", cp.charge_energy_added AS "kWh", cp.duration_min * 60 AS "Durée", cp.cost AS "Coût"
FROM charging_processes cp LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0 ORDER BY cp.start_date

value.title: Voir le détail de la recharge

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(date, '1m') AS time, avg(battery_level) AS "Batterie", avg(${preferred_range}_battery_range_km) AS "Autonomie"
FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(date, '1m') AS time, avg(elevation) AS "Altitude" FROM positions
WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(date) AND drive_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
